recommended_approach: Use Blender’s fluid simulation (Mantaflow) API by creating/configuring a fluid Domain via `bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings`, and a Flow/emitter via `bpy.types.FluidFlowSettings` (the core data-blocks referenced by the Blender 5.0 Python API for fluid domain/flow control).

domain_settings.noise_strength: `bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings.noise_strength` (available domain parameter to control noise influence/strength)
domain_settings.noise_time_anim: `bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings.noise_time_anim` (available domain parameter for animating noise over time)
domain_settings.flip_ratio: `bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings.flip_ratio` (available domain parameter for FLIP/PIC blending behavior)

flow_settings.noise_texture: `bpy.types.FluidFlowSettings.noise_texture` (available flow parameter for adding texture-driven noise)
